name: Tory Burch
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $362 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's shoes, handbags, clothing and jewelry, many with the Double T logo; Reva ballet flats run $275–$375. Sold through its own boutiques and website and through Nordstrom.

ownership.owner: River Light V, L.P. (private company behind the brand)

quote.q: Spring/Summer 2027 explores the psychology of how women pull things together. They want beauty, utility, and humor — the joy of getting dressed.

opview: “Spring/Summer 2027 explores the psychology of how women pull things together. They want beauty, utility, and humor — the joy of getting dressed.” — Tory Burch, founder, Spring/Summer 2027 runway page, toryburch.com

facts_read.source: brand site (About Us, runway, Tory Daily 2014-01-27); nordstrom.com; Vinted catalog page; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Tory Burch ready-to-wear and shoes; Tory Sport/'Sport' clothing not read (activewear sub-line with its own section); Runway pieces never used as a high

doors.note: site toryburch.com/en-us (/stores redirects to /en-us/store-locator/); 111 rows incl. 1 Puerto Rico: 65 own doors, 44 outlets (41 named Outlet, plus Jersey Gardens, Opry Mills and Pleasant Prairie counted as outlets by location, ruled 10 Oct: a store in an outlet center is an outlet), 1 pop-up (Mebane Pop Up, at Tanger Outlets Mebane, kept as a pop-up), and 1 counter (Macy's Herald Square - Coming Soon: no sign of a branded shop, so ruled 10 Oct: a counter, counted nowhere); 2 rows where the locator repeats the suite line were written once; plus 1 pop-up row(s); plus 1 department-store counter row(s), kept in return_doors.csv and counted nowhere

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 of 185 six-digit style codes on the first page of 6 clothing nodes (dresses 36, tops 27, sweaters 42, jackets 19, bottoms 49, coats 12);

craft_evidence.owned: no — none stated on the about page
craft_evidence.madein: 13 of 80 state a country (India 7, Italy 5, Portugal 2 — embellished pieces, denim and jacquards); the rest state none
craft_evidence.heritage: dated, not placed as making: 'Founded in 2004, Tory Burch has redefined American luxury' — a brand's founding
craft_evidence.process: partly — 'hand-applied crystal / mirror embellishment' on a few pages; no making process published
craft_evidence.reasoning: About one page in six states a country (Italy for the denim, India for hand-embellished pieces, Portugal for jacquards); no owned facility, maker or mill is named anywhere. The 2004 founding is a brand's, not a maker's.
